name: Dark Cleric Beryl
summary: In Brill, Dark Cleric Beryl guides newly awakened undead priests through shadow magic. From the Gallows' End Tavern, he helps them face their unholy existence under the Dark Lady.

sections.title: A Guide in the Shadows
sections.body: Upstairs in Brill's Gallows' End Tavern, Dark Cleric Beryl trains new Forsaken priests. He teaches that a priest's power comes from darkness and shadow, but mastering darkness also calls for knowledge of the light. Under his guidance, newly risen priests turn to shadow and the dark arts. Their first trials include crafting their Garments of Darkness and proving their dedication to this path.

faq.answer: Upstairs in Brill's Gallows' End Tavern, Dark Cleric Beryl trains Forsaken priests. He helps the newly risen broaden their spellcraft and embrace the shadows.

faq.q: Where can I find Dark Cleric Beryl?
faq.answer: Dark Cleric Beryl is upstairs in the Gallows' End Tavern in Brill, within Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Why do Forsaken priests use the title Dark Cleric?
faq.answer: Forsaken priests who leave behind the traditional dogmas of the Holy Light, or balance them with darker disciplines, take the title Dark Cleric. Their order teaches that the Forsaken were forged in corruption and that darkness is their home. A priest must learn to use both light and dark with discretion.
Beryl guides early Forsaken priest training, including In Favor of Darkness and Garments of Darkness. These teach young acolytes to aid their allies and wear vestments suited to shadow.

angles.text: As a Forsaken priest in Tirisfal Glades, you can turn to Beryl in Brill for guidance in shadow magic and the harsh passage into unholy power.
As an undead, you can see in Beryl how the Forsaken adapt to their cursed condition. They leave behind the blind devotion of Lordaeron's former faiths for practical, shadowy resilience.
